comments.author: @whiskerandwags1
comments.text:
People around the world are always going to have options about America, and that's fine. But we didn't become the greatest country in the world because other nations approved of us. We became the greatest because of our freedoms, opportunities, innovation, military strength, and the ability for people from all over the world to come here and build a better life.  

As Americans, we’ve become so accustomed to our standard of living that many of us take it for granted. We focus on our problems and forget that millions of people still dream of living here. No country is perfect, and America certainly has its flaws, but I’d rather live in a country that gives people the freedom to criticize it than in many places where they don’t even have that right.

 Other countries’ opinions DON'T define America. What matters is whether we continue to live up to the ideals that made this nation exceptional in the first place.
